title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Aisha Khan
description: Summary: Add a set of opinionated RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agent templates, a small suite of tool-calling examples, and three docs quickstarts to help developers get started quickly. Motivation: customers repeatedly ask for end-to-end RAG examples that show agent orchestration, tool calling, and recommended prompt/metadata conventions. This PR packages community-friendly templates and docs to reduce onboarding friction and surface best practices for Redwood runtime features (prefix caching, tool guards, structured outputs). Changes: - examples/rag/agent_templates/: three Python agents (qa_agent.py, summarizer_agent.py, multi_tool_agent.py) with small helper lib and README - examples/rag/tool_calling/: HTTP and SQL tool adapters + sample dataset and local runner - docs/quickstarts/rag-quickstart.md, docs/quickstarts/tool-calling-quickstart.md, docs/quickstarts/agent-templates.md - docs/snippets/: prompt templates and rollout guidance - updated docs sidebar and TOC entries Context & non-goals: This is intentionally example-driven; it does not change runtime behavior or add production plumbing. It includes guidance for both hosted and Dedicated/Private installs. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and tool adapters - [x] Write quickstart docs with runnable snippets - [x] Add CI example tests (unit + smoke) - [x] Manual review for security (tool sandboxing notes) - [x] Docs site nav and TOC updates Testing: - Unit tests for adapter shim (examples/test_adapter.py) - Smoke runner validated locally (python examples/rag/run_local.py) - Docs built and validated with mkdocs locally Known limitations: - Example agents use in-memory vector store (FAISS sample) for simplicity; production users should swap to managed stores. - SQL tool adapter is intentionally minimal and includes explicit warning about parameterized queries. Migration notes: None. Links: Docs preview: https://deploy-preview/rag-quickstart, Linear: ENG-2489. Release notes: see release_notes field.
